title: Hostinger coupon SONAR20: 20% off, where to enter the code and what it covers
seoTitle: Hostinger Coupon SONAR20 2026: 20% Off First Period
description: The Hostinger coupon SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period of an eligible new purchase, on a monthly or annual plan. See where to paste the code and what changes at renewal.
metaDescription: Hostinger coupon SONAR20: 20% off the first period, on a monthly or annual plan. See where to paste the code in the cart and what changes at renewal.
imageAlt: Logos of OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and Paperclip, with the Hostinger logo and the 20% discount

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Use **SONAR20** for 20% off the first period of an eligible new purchase at [Hostinger](/en/coupons/hostinger), on a monthly or annual plan, including a new product bought by an existing customer. Enter the code in the cart and check the discount before paying. Renewals are charged at the list price, without this discount.

contentSections.heading: What SONAR20 covers
paragraphs: SONAR20 is valid on all plans, monthly and annual, on a new purchase, including for people who are already Hostinger customers. On November 7, 2026, we tested it in the cart: with the code in the “Have a coupon code?” field on the global site, the 48-month Startup plan went from US$383.52 to US$306.82. In the test, the 20% came off the Black Friday price, and the code worked on its own, without the link. Those are that test's prices, not a current quote.

You can also visit Hostinger through the link in this article. In the cart, check the discount, the subscription period and the total before paying. If SONAR20 has not been applied, enter it in the coupon field.

contentSections.heading: Where to paste the code
paragraphs: Choose the plan and the period and go to the cart. In the order summary, click “Have a coupon code?”, paste **SONAR20** and apply it. The 20% discount shows up in the first-period total before you pay. The code is also on the [Hostinger page here on the site](/en/coupons/hostinger).

contentSections.heading: This site runs on Hostinger
paragraphs: Em Casa com Cecília runs on Hostinger, and Bruno has been a customer since 2024, with more than 24 months of subscription. He uses Business hosting, a KVM 2 VPS, Business email and domains, all with automatic renewal. Every time he had a problem, support solved it, mainly through the AI agent. Personally, he has never seen the service go down. That is his experience.

contentSections.heading: Monthly plan, annual plan and existing customers
paragraphs: SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period of an eligible new purchase on a monthly or annual plan. Existing customers can also qualify when buying a new product.
The code applies to all plans. Standalone domains and renewals are excluded. For email and AI agents, check whether the discount appears in your cart.
A new purchase is different from renewing a plan you already have: renewal is charged at the list price, without the 20% discount.

contentSections.heading: Renewal: what changes after the first period
paragraphs: After the first period, the plan renews at the standard price, shown below each plan's card, without the SONAR20 discount. The page says you can change the period or cancel at any time before renewal.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
bullets: Choose the plan and the period and go to the cart.
Paste SONAR20 in the coupon field and apply it.
Check that the 20% shows up in the first-period total and that the renewal is listed.
If the cart total differs from the prices on the page, the cart total is the one that counts.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Hostinger have a coupon? Yes: SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period of an eligible new purchase, on a monthly or annual plan. Standalone domains and renewals are excluded.
Where do I enter the Hostinger coupon? In the cart, in the “Have a coupon code?” field. Paste SONAR20 and apply it before paying.

Can existing customers use SONAR20? Yes, when buying an eligible new plan or product, rather than renewing one they already have. Apply the code and check the discount in the order summary before paying.
Does the coupon discount the renewal? No: renewal is charged at the list price, which the cart shows right below the plan. The 20% applies only to new purchases.
Does SONAR20 work on Black Friday? Yes: in the cart test, the 20% came off the campaign price. For a purchase today, apply SONAR20 and check your total before paying.
